verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's own marketing says it runs one agent that resolves issues end-to-end across chat, email, voice and SMS, and that it handles customer problems via phone. That directly claims voice support with the same agent used for chat, but it rests on two brief marketing lines with no detail on how calls are actually handled. missing for 10: documentation of speech recognition and text-to-speech, telephony setup and integration details, explicit confirmation that voice shares the same knowledge base and tool actions as chat, and independent or hands-on corroboration of voice quality.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent handles phone calls — speech in, speech out — with the same knowledge and actions as chat
